arxiv-2204-11815.title: Automatic Parameter Selection for Electron Ptychography via Bayesian Optimization
arxiv-2204-11815.creator: Michael C. Cao, Zhen Chen, Yi Jiang, Yimo Han
arxiv-2204-11815.description: Abstract Electron ptychography provides new opportunities to resolve atomic structures with deep sub-angstrom spatial resolution and studying electron-beam sensitive materials with high dose efficiency. In practice, obtaining accurate ptychography images requires simultaneously optimizing multiple parameters that are often selected based on trial-and-error, resulting in low-throughput experiments and preventing wider adoption.

arxiv-2303-16579.title: Decompositions of the positive real numbers into disjoint sets closed under addition and multiplication
arxiv-2303-16579.creator: Gergely Kiss, Gábor Somlai, Tamás Terpai
arxiv-2303-16579.description: Abstract The main purpose of this paper is to prove that the positive real numbers can be decomposed into finitely many disjoint pieces which are also closed under addition and multiplication. As a byproduct of the argument we determine all the possible decompositions of the transcendental extension of the rational field of rank one into two pieces.

arxiv-2308-09352.title: Subshifts of Finite Symbolic Rank Thanks: The first author acknowledges the partial support of his research by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (NSFC) grants 12250710128 and 12271263.
arxiv-2308-09352.creator: Su Gao, Ruiwen Li
arxiv-2308-09352.description: Abstract . The definition of subshifts of finite symbolic rank is motivated by the finite rank measure-preserving transformations which have been extensively studied in ergodic theory. In this paper we study subshifts of finite symbolic rank as essentially minimal Cantor systems.

arxiv-2501-13419.title: A Survey of Code-switched Arabic NLP: Progress, Challenges, and Future Directions
arxiv-2501-13419.creator: Injy Hamed, Caroline Sabty, Slim Abdennadher, Ngoc Thang Vu, Thamar Solorio, Nizar Habash
arxiv-2501-13419.description: Abstract Language in the Arab world presents a complex diglossic and multilingual setting, involving the use of Modern Standard Arabic, various dialects and sub-dialects, as well as multiple European languages. This diverse linguistic landscape has given rise to code-switching, both within Arabic varieties and between Arabic and foreign languages.

arxiv-2503-22615.title: Lagrangian multiforms and dispersionless integrable systems
arxiv-2503-22615.creator: Evgeny V. Ferapontov, Mats Vermeeren
arxiv-2503-22615.description: Abstract We demonstrate that interesting examples of Lagrangian multiforms appear naturally in the theory of multidimensional dispersionless integrable systems as (a) higher-order conservation laws of linearly degenerate PDEs in 3D, and (b) in the context of Gibbons-Tsarev equations governing hydrodynamic reductions of heavenly type equations in 4D. MSC2020: 35Q51, 35Q75, 37K10, 37K25, 53C25, 53Z05.

arxiv-2510-13765.title: Optimizing Supernova Classification with Interpretable Machine Learning Models
arxiv-2510-13765.creator: Anurag Garg 1, *
arxiv-2510-13765.description: Abstract Photometric classification of Type Ia supernovae (SNe Ia) is critical for cosmological studies but remains difficult due to class imbalance and observational noise. While deep learning models have been explored, they are often resource-intensive and lack interpretability. We present a computationally efficient and interpretable classification framework that maintains high performance on imbalanced datasets.

pmc-10514048.creator: Clémence Bonnet, Sheyla González, Sophie X Deng, Jie J Zheng
pmc-10514048.description: Limbal epithelial stem/progenitor cells (LSCs) are adult stem cells located at the limbus, tightly regulated by their niche involving numerous signaling pathways, such as Wnt. pmc-13331875.title: A Case of Bladder Paraganglioma With Negative Photodynamic Diagnosis Completely Resected by Staged En Bloc Transurethral Resection
pmc-13331875.creator: Shu Gozu, Yasukazu Nakanishi, Gaku Okumura, Erika Ikezoe, Naoki Imasato, Kohei Hirose, Madoka Kataoka, Shugo Yajima, Hitoshi Masuda
pmc-13331875.description: IntroductionBladder paraganglioma can be challenging to distinguish from nonpapillary bladder cancer. Here, we report a case of nonfunctional bladder paraganglioma treated with photodynamic diagnosis‐assisted en bloc transurethral resection of the bladder tumor.Case PresentationA 78‐year‐old man was incidentally diagnosed with a bladder tumor on imaging. Radiological and cystoscopic findings suggested bladder paraganglioma or nonpapillary urothelial carcinoma.

pmc-13445257.title: Total Parotidectomy Versus Less‐Than‐Total Parotidectomy for Early‐Stage Low Grade Parotid Cancer: A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis
pmc-13445257.creator: Nayeon Choi, Hye Ran Lee, Jungirl Seok, Heejun Yi, Sung Yool Park, Ji Hye Kwak, Woori Park, Sang Hoo Park, Eun‐Jae Chung, Soon‐Hyun Ahn, Jeon Yeob Jang, Gil Joon Lee
pmc-13445257.description: ObjectivesTotal parotidectomy (TP) has been advocated to ensure complete tumor clearance and removal of intraparotid lymph nodes; however, less‐than‐total parotidectomy (LTT) may offer comparable oncologic control with superior functional outcomes. In this systematic review and meta‐analysis, we compared oncologic and functional outcomes between LTT and TP for patients with T1–2 low‐grade parotid malignancies.

pmc-13536054.title: Immediate versus delayed dental implant placement: an umbrella review protocol
pmc-13536054.creator: Mateo Ron Canelos, Natalia de Oliveira Miranda, Juan Pablo Simbaña Balseca, César Magalhães Benfatti, Franz Strauss, Edwin Ruales-Carrera, Patrícia Pauletto, Gabriel Leonardo Magrin
pmc-13536054.description: IntroductionImmediate dental implant placement has been proposed as a strategy to reduce treatment time and improve patient satisfaction. However, systematic reviews addressing immediate versus delayed implant placement have reported inconsistent findings, limiting clinical interpretability. An umbrella review is warranted to synthesise, appraise and contextualise the existing evidence.
